```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
all_utts <- read_csv(here("../data/all_corpora_adj_noun_conc_utts.csv"))

sample_to_code <- all_utts %>%
  distinct(dataset, doc_id, sentence) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  sample_n(250) %>%
  ungroup()

#write_csv(sample_to_code, here("../data/all_corpora_utts_to_code.csv"))
```

```{r}
all_coded <- read_csv(here("../data/all_corpora_utts_to_code.csv")) %>%
  left_join(all_utts %>% select(dataset, doc_id, sentence, adj_token, noun_token), 
            by = c("dataset", "doc_id", "sentence")) %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(adj_token, noun_token, sep = " ")) %>%
  group_by(sentence, doc_id) %>%
  summarise(parser_pairs = list(pair)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(parser_pairs = as.list(tolower(str_squish(parser_pairs)))) %>%
  mutate(parser_pairs = if_else(typeof(parser_pairs) == "character", as.list(parser_pairs), parser_pairs))

bm <- read.csv(here("../data/all_corpora_utts_coded_BM.csv")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(adj, noun, sep = " ")) %>%
  group_by(sentence, doc_id) %>%
  summarise(bm_pairs = list(pair)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(bm_pairs = as.list(tolower(str_squish(bm_pairs))))
 
cb <- read.csv(here("../data/all_corpora_utts_coded_CB.csv")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(adj, noun, sep = " ")) %>%
  group_by(sentence, doc_id) %>%
  summarise(cb_pairs = list(pair)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cb_pairs = as.list(tolower(str_squish(cb_pairs))))

all_coded <- all_coded %>%
  left_join(bm, by = c("sentence", "doc_id")) %>%
  left_join(cb, by = c("sentence", "doc_id"))
```

```{r}
jaccard <- all_coded %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(human_intersect = list(intersect(bm_pairs, cb_pairs)),
         cb_parser_intersect = list(intersect(cb_pairs, parser_pairs)),
         bm_parser_intersect = list(intersect(bm_pairs, parser_pairs)),
         human_union = list(union(bm_pairs, cb_pairs)),
         cb_parser_union = list(union(cb_pairs, parser_pairs)),
         bm_parser_union = list(union(bm_pairs, parser_pairs))) 
```
